nom: Yadah Green Tea Pure Cleansing Balm

avis.texte: I have never been much of a cleanser person because I have very oily skin. I was a soap and water person for years. Since Covid, I have been using concealer as a foundation which has been harder to remove. I initially bought Physicians Formula The Perfect Matcha on an Amazon deal, which got me started down the cleanser path. I love that one and prefer the fragrance but the amount in the container was so small that this lead me to Yadah. Normally I am not a fan of citrus scent but this is a very light and pleasant fragrance so that I do enjoy this aspect of the product. It takes all my make up off thoroughly. It washes off easily. It leaves my skin in great condition. I think this has really brought my skin to the next level. It is also the perfect size so I don't have to keep buying product every month. Thank you, Yadah!

avis.titre: The best cleansing balm I’ve used so far!
avis.texte: I’m obsessed with cleansing balms! I never remove my makeup with anything other than a balm. I usually purchase the clean it ZERO balm. And while it’s a great product the price can be steep for a product that I go through quickly. I came across this product when searching for a balm that was more cost friendly. I had never heard of it beforehand, but I decided to give it a shot. I am SO glad that I did! It leaves my skin feeling soft the morning after I use it! My skin will feel so silky smooth that it’s hard not to touch it. It’s very lightly scented which is perfect for my sensitive skin. The scent is lovely as well! A little goes a long way so you’re definitely getting your value out of the product. I will definitely repurchase when I’m running low!

This product is the second time I have bought it, first it came in a box with skincare and I liked it so much that I had to look for it separately to buy it, it removes all the makeup without being abrasive to the skin, it removes even what you use that is against water , the skin is soft, I don't consider it to have a scent, it is neutral which is fine for me, it goes a long way. Please buy it.

I LOVE this and don't let size fool you it last. I have an oil based and water based cleanser and I have this one as well and I absolutely love it it feels amazing. Leaves my skin nourished. I pair this with a double cleanse, cucumber toner, key essence, numbzn 5+ concentrated serum, Moisturizer(I use baby magic I love it) and image skin care SPF zinc oxide face sunscreen. LOVE this product probably the most.

This does a good job of removing makeup, even mascara. It has a light scent. I found it to be very drying, which is odd considering the first ingredient is Olive Oil. I wouldn't consider it good for mature or sensitive skin. It seems to soak up oil, which may be better for those that need that, or don't want a greasy residue, which this rinsed off nicely. Not a bad product, but not the one for me.
LOVE this stuff. it smells so good, its smooth and easy to use. Can use on eye make up and it all comes right off.
